Landing.description_game: LUNAR PULSE ist ein Roguelite-Kartenspiel für Einzelspieler. Blitzschnelle Duelle, die in weniger als 60 Sekunden entschieden sind. Erlebe die Spannung eines „Death-Game“, bei dem ein Fehler zum sofortigen Tod führt. Das Besondere ist das Spielsystem mit simultanen Zügen bei offenen Karten.
Landing.guide_intro: This is the application form for the closed battle beta test, where you can get early access to the battles of “LUNAR PULSE” (<link>https://store.steampowered.com/app/2220860/</link>).
Landing.guide_intro_note: *The information you enter will be used only for running this test and as reference for development.
Landing.info_period_note: *Dates and times may change without prior notice.
Landing.guide_capacity_note1: *If there are more applicants than this, a lottery will be held.
Landing.guide_capacity_note2: *Only winners will be notified, by email by [ Monday, August 24, 2026, 23:59 ] (JST), together with details on how to participate.
Landing.info_notice_desc: Winners will receive an email from the address below.
Landing.guide_notice_note1: *The email may be sorted into your spam folder, so please check there as well.
Landing.guide_notice_note2: *To make sure you receive it, please add the address above to your contacts or allow emails from it.
Landing.info_req_steam: Steam account (Steam Playtest is used. Full operation on Steam Deck is not guaranteed)
Landing.info_req_google: Google account (the winner notification is sent to this account's email address)
Landing.info_req_discord: Joining the official “LUNAR PULSE” Discord server (<link>https://discord.gg/hSC8dgfkaz</link>)
Landing.info_stream_desc: You may publish your play of this test through streaming or on SNS.
Landing.info_stream_desc2: When you do, please state that it is a work-in-progress build.
Landing.form_email_sub: Your Steam Playtest key and surveys will be sent to this address.
Landing.discord_hint_1: (Enter your unique user name, not your display name.)
Landing.discord_hint_warn: ※ If the account cannot be confirmed, you will be disqualified.
Landing.form_consent_sub: Please check all items to apply:
Landing.consent_1: I can prepare the required Windows PC environment myself.
Landing.consent_2: I understand this is a development build that may contain bugs and unadjusted features.
Landing.consent_3: I will NOT transfer or disclose my Steam Playtest key to third parties.
Landing.consent_4: I will answer the feedback survey after the test.
Landing.consent_5: I am 13 or older (under 18: I have parental consent).
Landing.form_privacy_legal: Personal data is used only for playtest operation, under the Fahrenheit213 privacy policy.
Landing.modal_desc: Thank you for applying. If selected, your key and instructions will be emailed before the test begins.
Landing.err_email_invalid: Please enter a valid email address.
Landing.err_discord_required: Please enter your Discord user name.
Landing.err_discord_invalid: Invalid Discord user name: use 6–32 letters, numbers, underscores or periods (no two periods in a row).
Landing.err_consent_required: Please check all agreements to apply.
Landing.err_submit_failed: Could not submit your application. Please try again later.
Landing.form_wishlist_label: Have you added Tsurugi Hime to your Steam wishlist?
Landing.confirm_desc: Please check your entries. Your application is sent when you press Submit.

Landing.apply_done_not_selected: Please note that applicants who are not selected will not be contacted.

Landing.apply_done_allow: *To make sure you receive it, please add this address to your contacts or allow emails from it.
